ZephyrSid.name: X-Zephyr-Sid
ZephyrSid.description: Existing SQLite-backed Zephyr app session returned only to native clients.

DeviceAccess.description: Short-lived mobile access credential. Refresh credential is never used as bearer access.

DeviceProof.name: X-Zephyr-Device-Proof
DeviceProof.description: Required with DeviceAccess on every device data-plane request. ES256 SHA-256 signature in fixed 64-byte P1363 form over the v2 canonical payload returned by the access-authenticated challenge endpoint. X-Zephyr-Server-Nonce and X-Zephyr-Proof-Timestamp are mandatory; the nonce is server-generated, request-bound, short-lived and single-use.

bindingRevision.description: Monotonic server authority revision for device credential binding.

tokenSecret.description: Legacy independent proof for initial bind only. Rebinding requires a server-issued sensitive-verification attempt.

bindingProtocolVersion.description: Optional explicit opt-in for clients that echo bindReceipt. Omitted by legacy v1 clients.

bindReceipt.description: Server-issued single-use receipt from SensitiveGrant.bindAttempt. The grant remains the legacy-compatible carrier when this is omitted.

bindingRevision.description: Stable for an idempotent replay of the same bind receipt.

bindingToken.description: Stable non-bearer confirmation token for this binding revision.

PushConflict.description: Owner-scoped canonical server view for a field-overlap conflict. serverPayload contains only registry editable/opaque-preserve fields plus the typed account owner, is at most 2 MiB of UTF-8 JSON, and has a maximum JSON depth of 16. If the server cannot prove those invariants the operation is rejected with cursor_invalid so the client restarts bootstrap instead of persisting a conflict.

serverPayload.description: Safe current canonical projection. It MUST contain the entity registry ownerField equal to the authenticated account and MUST NOT contain secret, device-local, other server-authority, shared, foreign, or server-only data.

fields.description: Legacy overlap alias. New clients use serverChangedFields.

bindingProtocolVersion.description: Optional explicit v2 marker. Legacy bind verification requests remain valid without it.

BindAttempt.description: One server-issued bind CAS receipt. The raw receipt must not be logged, persisted in feeds, or sent for another owner/device/token tuple.

bodySha256.description: Padded standard Base64 SHA-256 of the exact request bytes.

usage.description: Optional assertion; when present it must equal the server-derived usage.

timestamp.description: Server-issued Unix timestamp in seconds. Sign and echo it unchanged.

expiresAt.description: Challenge expiry as Unix epoch milliseconds.
